HSM_AQR_record_native_outcome = {
if = { limit = {
 HSM_AQR_active = yes HSM_AQR_outcome = yes
 NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_native_outcome_recorded }
}
 # Peaceful native resolution has a global result but no local flag. Freeze it
 # once, before subsequent national restoration changes the global government.
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = REVOLUTION_is_a_monarchist } NOT = { has_country_flag = REVOLUTION_is_a_revolutionary } }
  if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_won_royal = yes } set_country_flag = REVOLUTION_is_a_monarchist }
  else = { set_country_flag = REVOLUTION_is_a_revolutionary }
 }
 set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_native_outcome_recorded
 HSM_AQR_snapshot_native_politics = yes
}
}

HSM_AQR_opening = {
if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_postwar_opening_ready = yes }
 HSM_AQR_record_native_outcome = yes
 HSM_AQR_queue_native_settlement = yes
}
}

HSM_AQR_open_postwar = {
if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_postwar_opening_ready = yes }
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = HSM_AQR_opening } }
  complete_national_focus = HSM_AQR_opening
 }
 HSM_AQR_opening = yes
}
}

HSM_AQR_queue_native_settlement = {
if = { limit = {
 HSM_AQR_native_can_reopen = yes
 NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_native_settlement_requested }
 NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_native_settlement_presented }
}
 set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_native_settlement_requested
 set_country_flag = { flag = HSM_AQR_native_settlement_queued days = 7 }
 if = { limit = { original_tag = JEB } country_event = { id = HSM_AQR.410 days = 1 } } if = { limit = { original_tag = JRR } country_event = { id = HSM_AQR.411 days = 1 } } if = { limit = { original_tag = JFT } country_event = { id = HSM_AQR.412 days = 1 } } if = { limit = { original_tag = VIN } country_event = { id = HSM_AQR.413 days = 1 } }
}
}

HSM_AQR_finish_JEB_royal_pledge = {
if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_can_pledge_JEB_royal = yes } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_route_JEB_royal }
}

HSM_AQR_finish_JEB_royal_organise = {
if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_local_rule = yes HSM_AQR_eligible_JEB_royal = yes has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_route_JEB_royal NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_finish_JEB_royal_organise_done } }
set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_finish_JEB_royal_organise_done
add_political_power = 35
}
}

HSM_AQR_finish_JEB_royal_settle = {
if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_can_settle_JEB_royal = yes } country_event = { id = HSM_AQR.100 days = 1 } }
}

HSM_AQR_ratify_JEB_royal_a = {
if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_can_ratify_JEB_royal = yes }
add_political_power = -50
set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_ratified
set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_ratified_JEB_royal
set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_constitution_a
if = { limit = { has_character = JEB_duke_michel_discret }
 if = { limit = { JEB_duke_michel_discret = { has_ideology = constitutional_monarchism } }
  promote_character = { character = JEB_duke_michel_discret ideology = constitutional_monarchism }
 }
 else = { add_country_leader_role = { character = JEB_duke_michel_discret country_leader = { ideology = constitutional_monarchism expire = "1060.1.1" } promote_leader = yes } }
 set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no }
}
set_party_name = { ideology = neutrality name = HSM_AQR_JEB_royal_party long_name = HSM_AQR_JEB_royal_party }
set_popularities = { democratic = 15 communism = 15 fascism = 15 neutrality = 55 }
HSM_AQR_refresh = yes
mark_focus_tree_layout_dirty = yes
}
}

HSM_AQR_ratify_JEB_royal_b = {
if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_can_ratify_JEB_royal = yes }
add_political_power = -50
set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_ratified
set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_ratified_JEB_royal
set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_constitution_b
if = { limit = { has_character = JEB_duke_michel_discret }
 if = { limit = { JEB_duke_michel_discret = { has_ideology = constitutional_monarchism } }

HSM_AQR_apply_national_identity = {
if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_national = yes }
 if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_republican_national_programme = yes }
  if = { limit = { NOT = { has_cosmetic_tag = JER_REPUBLIC } } set_cosmetic_tag = JER_REPUBLIC }
 }
 else = {
  if = { limit = { NOT = { has_cosmetic_tag = HSM_AQR_KINGDOM } } set_cosmetic_tag = HSM_AQR_KINGDOM }
 }
}
}

HSM_AQR_refresh_national_identity = {
if = { limit = {
 HSM_AQR_national = yes
 OR = { has_cosmetic_tag = JER_formed has_cosmetic_tag = JER_JFT_formed has_cosmetic_tag = JER_REPUBLIC has_cosmetic_tag = HSM_AQR_KINGDOM }
}
 HSM_AQR_apply_national_identity = yes
}
}

}

 JEB = { set_country_flag = { flag = HSM_AQR_offer_pending days = 30 } country_event = { id = HSM_AQR.20 days = 2 } }
}
if = { limit = { NOT = { original_tag = JRR } JRR = { exists = yes has_war = no OR = { is_subject = no is_subject_of = ROOT } NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_offer_refused } NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_offer_pending } } }
 JRR = { set_country_flag = { flag = HSM_AQR_offer_pending days = 30 } country_event = { id = HSM_AQR.20 days = 2 } }
}
if = { limit = { NOT = { original_tag = JFT } JFT = { exists = yes has_war = no OR = { is_subject = no is_subject_of = ROOT } NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_offer_refused } NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_offer_pending } } }
 JFT = { set_country_flag = { flag = HSM_AQR_offer_pending days = 30 } country_event = { id = HSM_AQR.20 days = 2 } }
}
if = { limit = { NOT = { original_tag = VIN } VIN = { exists = yes has_war = no OR = { is_subject = no is_subject_of = ROOT } NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_offer_refused } NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_offer_pending } } }

}
 }

HSM_AQR_partition = {
if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_can_partition = yes }
set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_partition_done
if = { limit = { JHZ = { exists = no } } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_new_JHZ }
every_owned_state = {
 limit = { HSM_AQR_herzland_state = yes NOT = { HSM_AQR_border_state = yes } is_fully_controlled_by = PREV }
 remove_core_of = ROOT
 add_core_of = JHZ
 transfer_state_to = JHZ
}
puppet = JHZ
JHZ = { set_country_flag = JER_puppet set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_herzland_settlement }
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_new_JHZ }
 JHZ = {
  set_capital = { state = 382 remember_old_capital = no }
  inherit_technology = PREV
  load_focus_tree = { tree = generic_griffon_focus keep_completed = no }
 }
 clr_country_flag = HSM_AQR_new_JHZ
}
JHZ = {
  if = { limit = { ROOT = { OR = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_ratified_JEB_royal has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_ratified_JEB_constitutional has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_ratified_JRR_absolutist has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_ratified_JRR_coalition has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_ratified_JFT_dennis has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_ratified_VIN_gadiffer } } }
   set_cosmetic_tag = JER_PUPPET
   if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_government = democratic } } set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = yes } }
   else = { set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no } }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_government = fascism } }
   set_cosmetic_tag = JER_REPUBLIC_PUPPET set_politics = { ruling_party = fascism elections_allowed = no }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_government = communism } }
   set_cosmetic_tag = JER_REPUBLIC_PUPPET set_politics = { ruling_party = communism elections_allowed = no }
  }
  else_if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_government = neutrality } }
   set_cosmetic_tag = JER_REPUBLIC_PUPPET set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no }
  }
  else = { set_cosmetic_tag = JER_REPUBLIC_PUPPET set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = yes } }
}
}
}

HSM_AQR_snapshot_transition_centre = {
if = { limit = { JER = { has_government = neutrality } } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_transition_centre_neutrality }
if = { limit = { JER = { has_government = democratic } } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_transition_centre_democratic }
if = { limit = { JER = { has_government = fascism } } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_transition_centre_fascism }
if = { limit = { JER = { has_government = communism } } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_transition_centre_communism }
if = { limit = { JER = { has_country_flag = JER_is_monarchist } } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_transition_JER_is_monarchist }
if = { limit = { JER = { has_country_flag = JER_democracy_established } } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_transition_JER_democracy_established }
}

HSM_AQR_begin_postwar_choice = {
if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_can_deliver_postwar_choice = yes }
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_postwar_choice_requested } }
  HSM_AQR_snapshot_transition_centre = yes
 }
 set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_postwar_choice_requested
 set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_postwar_choice_delivered
 clr_country_flag = HSM_AQR_postwar_choice_queued
}

}

HSM_AQR_cleanup_postwar_choice = {
if = { limit = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_postwar_choice_requested NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_postwar_choice_delivered } NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_postwar_choice_answered } NOT = { AND = { HSM_AQR_postwar_choice_context = yes HSM_AQR_transition_centre_unchanged = yes } } }
clr_country_flag = HSM_AQR_postwar_choice_requested
clr_country_flag = HSM_AQR_postwar_choice_queued
clr_country_flag = HSM_AQR_postwar_choice_delivered
clr_country_flag = HSM_AQR_transition_centre_neutrality
clr_country_flag = HSM_AQR_transition_centre_democratic
clr_country_flag = HSM_AQR_transition_centre_fascism
clr_country_flag = HSM_AQR_transition_centre_communism

HSM_AQR_continue_at_centre = {
if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_valid_central_demand = yes
HSM_AQR_local_rule = yes HSM_AQR_revolution_finished = yes HSM_AQR_outcome = yes
OR = { AND = { tag = JEB original_tag = JEB } AND = { tag = JRR original_tag = JRR } AND = { tag = JFT original_tag = JFT } AND = { tag = VIN original_tag = VIN } }
exists = yes has_capitulated = no
NOT = { has_war_with = JER }
OR = { is_subject = no is_subject_of = JER }
JER = { exists = yes original_tag = JER is_subject = no has_capitulated = no }
NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_nation }
NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_postwar_choice_answered }
NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_leadership_war_started }

FROM = { tag = JER exists = yes original_tag = JER is_subject = no has_capitulated = no }
has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_postwar_choice_delivered
HSM_AQR_transition_centre_unchanged = yes
 is_ai = no JER = { is_ai = yes } }
set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_postwar_choice_answered
clr_country_flag = HSM_AQR_postwar_choice_queued
if = { limit = { tag = JEB original_tag = JEB }
 JER = { change_tag_from = JEB }
 JER = {
  if = { limit = { exists = yes original_tag = JER JEB = { exists = yes } }
   annex_country = { target = JEB transfer_troops = yes }
  }
 }
}
else_if = { limit = { tag = JRR original_tag = JRR }
 JER = { change_tag_from = JRR }
 JER = {
  if = { limit = { exists = yes original_tag = JER JRR = { exists = yes } }
   annex_country = { target = JRR transfer_troops = yes }
  }
 }
}
else_if = { limit = { tag = JFT original_tag = JFT }
 JER = { change_tag_from = JFT }
 JER = {
  if = { limit = { exists = yes original_tag = JER JFT = { exists = yes } }
   annex_country = { target = JFT transfer_troops = yes }
  }
 }
}
else_if = { limit = { tag = VIN original_tag = VIN }
 JER = { change_tag_from = VIN }
 JER = {
  if = { limit = { exists = yes original_tag = JER VIN = { exists = yes } }
   annex_country = { target = VIN transfer_troops = yes }
  }
 }
}
}
}

exists = yes has_capitulated = no

HSM_AQR_national_countermandate = {
if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_valid_central_demand = yes
HSM_AQR_local_rule = yes HSM_AQR_revolution_finished = yes HSM_AQR_outcome = yes
OR = { AND = { tag = JEB original_tag = JEB } AND = { tag = JRR original_tag = JRR } AND = { tag = JFT original_tag = JFT } AND = { tag = VIN original_tag = VIN } }
exists = yes has_capitulated = no
NOT = { has_war_with = JER }
OR = { is_subject = no is_subject_of = JER }
JER = { exists = yes original_tag = JER is_subject = no has_capitulated = no }
NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_nation }
NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_postwar_choice_answered }
NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_leadership_war_started }

FROM = { tag = JER exists = yes original_tag = JER is_subject = no has_capitulated = no }
has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_postwar_choice_delivered
HSM_AQR_transition_centre_unchanged = yes
 }
set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_postwar_choice_answered
clr_country_flag = HSM_AQR_postwar_choice_queued
set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_central_refusal
if = { limit = { is_subject_of = JER } JER = { end_puppet = ROOT } }
if = { limit = { is_in_faction_with = JER }
 if = { limit = { is_faction_leader = yes } remove_from_faction = JER }
 else = { leave_faction = yes }
}
if = { limit = { has_non_aggression_pact_with = JER }
 diplomatic_relation = { country = JER relation = non_aggression_pact active = no }
}
if = { limit = { has_truce_with = JER } set_truce = { target = JER days = 0 } }
diplomatic_relation = { country = JER relation = guarantee active = no }
JER = { diplomatic_relation = { country = ROOT relation = guarantee active = no } }
declare_war_on = { target = JER type = annex_everything }

 if = { limit = { has_war_with = JER }
  set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_leadership_war_started
  set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_national_countermandate_done
  set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_national_mandate_done
  if = { limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = HSM_AQR_national_mandate } }
   complete_national_focus = HSM_AQR_national_mandate
  }
 }
}

}

HSM_AQR_RESTORE_royal = {
if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_RESTORE_royal_ready = yes }
set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_RESTORE_signed
if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_RESTORE_existing_royal = yes } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_RESTORE_preserve_national_campaign }
if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_RESTORE_has_JER_king_moriset_discret = yes } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_RESTORE_moriset }
377 = { transfer_state_to = JER }
if = { limit = { has_character = JER_king_moriset_discret } JER_king_moriset_discret = { set_nationality = JER } }
if = { limit = { has_character = JER_vivienne_discret } JER_vivienne_discret = { set_nationality = JER } }
JER = {
 if = { limit = { is_subject = yes } overlord = { end_puppet = PREV } }
 set_capital = { state = 377 remember_old_capital = no }
 inherit_technology = ROOT
 clr_global_flag = JER_revolution_begun
 clr_global_flag = JER_revolution_ended_2
 set_global_flag = JER_revolution_ended
 # Retain completed economic and military work; remove the opposing political
 # prerequisites so that the restored movement's own native route can proceed.
 if = { limit = { ROOT = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_RESTORE_preserve_national_campaign } } }
  uncomplete_national_focus = { focus = JER_fight_for_freedom uncomplete_children = yes refund_political_power = no }
  load_focus_tree = { tree = aquileian_focus keep_completed = yes }
  if = { limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = JER_state_of_aquileia } } complete_national_focus = JER_state_of_aquileia }
  set_politics = { ruling_party = neutrality elections_allowed = no }
  set_country_flag = JER_is_monarchist
clr_country_flag = JER_democracy_established
drop_cosmetic_tag = yes
if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_RESTORE_moriset } }
 promote_character = JER_king_moriset_discret
}
else = {
 if = { limit = { has_character = JER_king_moriset_discret } retire_character = JER_king_moriset_discret }
 promote_character = JER_vivienne_discret
 # Moriset's fall has already happened: do not select the focus that shoots him.
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = JER_to_kill_an_idea } }
  complete_national_focus = JER_to_kill_an_idea
 }
}
remove_ideas = JER_revolutionary

 }
 if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_begin_done } }
remove_ideas = HSM_AQR_REC_crisis
remove_ideas = HSM_AQR_REC_roofs
remove_ideas = HSM_AQR_REC_returning_workers
if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_begin_done } } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_begin_done }
if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_postwar_housing_done } } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_postwar_housing_done }
if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_demobilisation_done } } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_demobilisation_done }
if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_food_networks_done } } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_food_networks_done }

}
}

HSM_AQR_RESTORE_republic = {
if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_RESTORE_republic_ready = yes }
set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_RESTORE_signed
if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_RESTORE_existing_republic = yes } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_RESTORE_preserve_national_campaign }
if = { limit = { HSM_AQR_RESTORE_has_JER_king_moriset_discret = yes } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_RESTORE_moriset }
377 = { transfer_state_to = JER }
if = { limit = { has_character = JER_theodore_verany } JER_theodore_verany = { set_nationality = JER } }
JER = {
 if = { limit = { is_subject = yes } overlord = { end_puppet = PREV } }
 set_capital = { state = 377 remember_old_capital = no }
 inherit_technology = ROOT
 clr_global_flag = JER_revolution_begun
 clr_global_flag = JER_revolution_ended
 set_global_flag = JER_revolution_ended_2
 # Retain completed economic and military work; remove the opposing political
 # prerequisites so that the restored movement's own native route can proceed.
 if = { limit = { ROOT = { NOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_RESTORE_preserve_national_campaign } } }
  uncomplete_national_focus = { focus = JER_state_of_aquileia uncomplete_children = yes refund_political_power = no }
  load_focus_tree = { tree = aquileian_focus keep_completed = yes }
  if = { limit = { NOT = { has_completed_focus = JER_fight_for_freedom } } complete_national_focus = JER_fight_for_freedom }
  set_politics = { ruling_party = democratic elections_allowed = no }
  clr_country_flag = JER_is_monarchist
set_country_flag = JER_democracy_established
set_cosmetic_tag = JER_REPUBLIC
promote_character = { character = JER_theodore_verany ideology = liberalism }
set_popularities = { democratic = 50 communism = 20 fascism = 20 neutrality = 10 }
set_country_flag = have_regular_puppets
clr_country_flag = JER_cant_do_war_focuses
remove_ideas = JER_memories
remove_ideas = JER_memories_2

 }
 if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_begin_done } }
remove_ideas = HSM_AQR_REC_crisis
remove_ideas = HSM_AQR_REC_roofs
remove_ideas = HSM_AQR_REC_returning_workers

if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_postwar_housing_done } } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_postwar_housing_done }
if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_demobilisation_done } } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_demobilisation_done }
if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_food_networks_done } } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_food_networks_done }
if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_peripheral_conference_done } } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_peripheral_conference_done }
if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_peripheral_articles_done } } set_country_flag = HSM_AQR_REC_peripheral_articles_done }
if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_idea = HSM_AQR_REC_crisis } } add_ideas = HSM_AQR_REC_crisis }
if = { limit = { ROOT = { has_idea = HSM_AQR_REC_roofs } } add_ideas = HSM_AQR_REC_roofs }
